## Parallax.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `speed` :: How strongly the layer lags the scroll (positive) or leads it (negative). Typical range is -1 to 1.
- `axis` :: The axis of travel.
- `children` :: The layer content.

### `const layer`

CSS scroll-driven animation (`animation-timeline: view()` + `.parallax-view`) where the platform supports it; otherwise the `parallax()` attachment and the `.motion` channels.

## ParallaxGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The layered scene — typically several `Parallax` children at different speeds.
